scope: Public constructed connected-pin decisions; private owner branches are excluded. Scores are side-to-move engine estimates, not local material bounds or independent puzzle counts.

motifs.label: Pin
motifs.evidence: Bd5 pins the rook on f3 to its king on h1. Every legal defence concedes material in the checked continuations, but not always the pinned piece: Qxg7+ permits Kxg7. Captures, compensation and immediate counterplay are included; this is a local material bound, not a full-position evaluation.

motifs.label: Discovered Attack
motifs.evidence: Bd5 vacates f7, uncovering the rook on f8 against the rook on f3. Every legal reply allows material gain or a short forced mate, including checking answers to countercaptures. Captures and interpositions are included in this check.

timeline.label: Winning Recapture
timeline.evidence: Rxf3 takes the queen on f3 in exchange for the bishop just captured there. After allowing for that trade and immediate counterplay, the checked local gain is at least 5.7 pawns; this is the payoff, not a newly hanging piece.

motifs.label: X-Ray Support
motifs.evidence: Bxf3+ uses the rook on f8 behind the opposing queen on f6. If Qxf3, that piece vacates the ray and allows Rxf3, preserving the material gain. This is support for the exchange on f3, not another attack at its eventual payoff.
